import { describe, it, test, beforeEach, expect } from "vitest";
import { CheckoutService } from "../src/checkout_service";

describe("CheckoutService", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // setup
  });

  it("computes total", () => {
    const svc = new CheckoutService();
    expect(svc.total([1, 2, 3])).toBe(6);
  });

  test("rejects empty cart", () => {
    const svc = new CheckoutService();
    expect(() => svc.checkout([])).toThrow();
  });

  it("emits checkout.created", () => {
    const topic = "checkout.created";
    expect(topic).toBe("checkout.created");
  });
});
